newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts to see gains above 115-05 peak.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts to see gains above 115-05 peak.

text.p: September gilt futures on LIFFE may be able to take out the July 2 peak of 115-05 on Monday after a brief period of consolidation, technical analysts said.
But gains above a daily channel line coming in at 115-28 will be hard-fought, they said.
Andy Cossor, fixed income analyst at Technical Data said above 115-28 there was little in the way until the continuation level of 116-23.
"I wouldn't be surprised to see a modicum of correction but the underlying tone is pretty good," said Cossor.
By 0710 GMT, September gilts were down 3/32 at 114-24.
